svg.title: Proposed filter analysis architecture
svg.desc: Experimental FiltersAPI supplies serialized filter entities and privileged observations to a background coordinator. Portable analysis produces findings for extension pages. Explicit edits return through native validation. Backups can supply offline analysis data.

g.text: Proposed filter analysis architecture
Shared backup entities + separate live observations + explicit native actions
Experimental FiltersAPI
Native filter reading and serialization | folder and provider observations
Session tokens | current-state validation | edits, save and rollback
Only privileged operations and facts; plain data crosses the boundary.
Background coordinator
Jobs, usage policy, snapshots and cancellation
scripts/filter-analysis/
Portable rules, evidence evaluation and collation
Extension pages
Localize, render, report and confirm actions
Saved backup adapter
Reuse entities; live facts remain unknown
Entities + observations
Explicit edits
Findings
Offline snapshot
Confirmed action returns to coordinator, then native validation
Future standard API: replace acquisition adapter; retain portable rules and presentation.
Discussion draft, 2026-11-12. Companion overview to architecture.mmd.
